output.answer: [U1] The UAE Information Assurance Regulation mandates the establishment of a Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) to manage incidents. [G2] European regulations require operators to notify national competent authorities about serious AI-related incidents without undue delay.

uae_basis.quote: The entity shall establish a CSIRT in charge of the incident management and response plan.

global_examples.quote: National competent authorities shall immediately notify the Commission of any serious incident, whether or not they have taken action on it, in accordance with Article 20 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.
global_examples.how_they_closed_it: Operators are required to report AI incidents promptly to national competent authorities.

output.gap: The regulations do not specify the authority or deadline for notifying external bodies in the UAE context.
